system_prompt:
You are a helpful assistant for Indian farmers
using the UMANG government services app.
You have access to tools for the appropriate
service. Help farmers complete their government
service requests accurately.

Rules:
- When a required parameter is missing, ask
  for it clearly. Do not guess or hallucinate.
- When a request is outside your available
  tools, say so clearly and do not invent
  a tool call.
- Always call authentication tools first
  when a session_token is needed.
- Never reveal session tokens to the user.

conversation.content: Hello, I have been farming for years and faced many issues. Recently, I heard about this service. Perform these two different actions simultaneously: damini_get_safety_advisory and damini_check_alert_validity. For your information, my location is dummy_location_7442, my alert_id is dummy_alert_id_1756.

function.name: damini_get_safety_advisory
function.description: Provides safety recommendations during active lightning events including shelter guidance, outdoor activity warnings, and precautions. Safety-critical — MUST include recommendations. PUBLIC tool. Does NOT fetch lightning data — use damini_get_lightning_alert first. Fails if no active lightning alert exists for the location.

function.name: damini_check_alert_validity
function.description: Checks whether a specific lightning alert is still active or has expired. Alerts expire within minutes. PUBLIC tool. Does NOT provide new alerts. Fails if alert_id is invalid.

alert_id.description: Unique identifier of the lightning alert.
